title: Check that the runner works
hints: Only one character group changes: the `0` after the `=` sign.
Replace `0` with `42`, so the line reads `let answer = 42`. Then press Submit.

answer.explain: The line `let answer = 42` gives the value 42 the name `answer`. Every test asks for `answer` and checks what comes back, so once the number is 42 they all pass.
